tower.imports.holdRecorded: Recorded. The other party can see it and answer it.
tower.imports.holdAnswered: Your account is on the record beside theirs.
tower.imports.needPort: Give the port’s position, so a driver knows where to collect.
tower.imports.needDest: Say where the container is going.
tower.byAir.title: By air
tower.byAir.lede: The cargo waits in the handler’s shed until customs, every agency the goods need and the handler’s delivery order have released it. Until then nobody is offered the road leg from the shed, so no truck is sent to wait. The notice of arrival alone releases nothing.
tower.byAir.fold.none: Record the air waybill and the shed it waits in
tower.byAir.fold.waiting: {n, plural, one {# release} other {# releases}} still to come
tower.byAir.fold.anyway: Sent before the release, on your word
tower.byAir.held: Air waybill {awb} ({airline}), {flights}. Waits at {handler}: {pieces} pieces, {kg} kg.
tower.byAir.temp: Kept between {min} and {max} °C on the road.
tower.byAir.releasedLine: Every release is recorded: the road leg is open to drivers.
tower.byAir.anywaySaid: {by} sent the truck before the release on {when}: “{reason}”. Its waiting is the importer’s.
tower.byAir.clock.notStarted: The free storage starts when the handler’s notice of arrival is recorded.
tower.byAir.clock.notStartedNoHours: Give the handler’s free hours, from its notice or tariff, to count them from its notice of arrival.
tower.byAir.clock.noFreeHours: At {handler} since the notice of arrival; give its free hours to count them.
tower.byAir.clock.dueSoon: The free storage at {handler} ends at {until}: {left} h left. Collect it before then.
tower.byAir.clock.over: The free storage at {handler} ended at {until}. Each hour or day over is the handler’s to charge, under its tariff.
tower.byAir.clock.stopped: Collected from the shed at {when}: the free storage has stopped.
tower.byAir.step.customs: Customs release (the release order or entry)
tower.byAir.step.deliveryOrder: The handler’s delivery order or gate pass
tower.byAir.step.handlerCharges: The handler’s charges paid (storage and handling)
tower.byAir.slotTitle: The truck’s slot at the shed
tower.byAir.f.landedIn: Country it landed in (two letters), if its airport is not one we know
tower.byAir.f.builtUp: Built up on airline pallets or containers — how many, if it is collected so
tower.byAir.builtUpLine: {n, plural, one {# airline pallet or container, built up} other {# airline pallets or containers, built up}}: only a truck with a roller floor is offered the road leg.
tower.byAir.transitLine: It landed in {landed}, not in {dest}: customs at the airport release it for transit, and the road leg runs under bond across the border. The agencies of {dest} look at it there, where it is cleared.
tower.byAir.slotNone: No slot recorded. Where the shed gives trucks a slot, record it: the driver is told to come inside it.
tower.byAir.collected: Collected from the shed {when}: {counted, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} counted, against the waybill’s {pieces}.
tower.byAir.complainBy: Complain to {airline} in writing by {by}, quoting air waybill {awb}: the law gives that long from receipt for damage.
tower.byAir.complainNow: Complain to {airline} in writing at once, quoting air waybill {awb}: no convention sets the days here, the airline’s conditions do.
tower.byAir.refOptional: Its reference, if it has one
tower.byAir.notifiedNote: Leave the time empty for now. Each step is the importer’s or its agent’s word: SeeBuyGet judges none of them, and cannot say when a release will come.
tower.byAir.anywayTitle: Send the truck before the release
tower.byAir.anywayHint: Your agent says it will be out within the hour, or the shed confirmed by phone: you may open the road leg now. The release is still missing; a truck sent early may wait at the shed, and that waiting is yours.
tower.byAir.f.waitingIsMine: If the truck waits at the shed, its waiting is ours
tower.byAir.lawUnread: We have not read the law of this route yet.
tower.byAir.change: Change the air waybill or the agencies
tower.byAir.formHint: Copy these from the air waybill and the handler’s notice of arrival. The steps already recorded are kept when you change them.
tower.byAir.awbShort: Eleven digits: the airline’s three, and eight more.
tower.byAir.awbWrong: The last digit does not check: look at the number again.
tower.byAir.f.airline: Airline (only if we do not know its prefix)
tower.byAir.kind.master: The airline’s, under which a forwarder grouped cargo
tower.byAir.kind.direct: The airline’s, made out to us direct
tower.byAir.agenciesTitle: Who must release it besides customs ({country})
tower.byAir.agenciesHint: Tick the ones these goods need — your agent knows the border. Suggested by the goods, never required by us. {source}
tower.byAir.agenciesNone: We have not read which agencies release air cargo in {country} yet: customs and the handler’s delivery order are asked.
tower.byAir.freeHint: Copy the free hours from the handler’s notice or tariff. SeeBuyGet counts hours, never what an hour over costs.
tower.byAir.freeHint.KE: Kenya Airways’ published tariff at Jomo Kenyatta airport (1 February 2013, the only one found) gives imports 48 free hours — check the figure on your handler’s notice. SeeBuyGet counts hours, never what an hour over costs.
tower.animals.title: Live animals
tower.animals.hint: Copy these from the permit and the veterinary health certificate. Their originals ride with the animals; a species listed under CITES rides with its permit too. SeeBuyGet keeps the numbers and signs nothing for anybody.
tower.animals.kind.livestock: Livestock, walking on (cattle, goats, sheep, pigs, horses)
tower.animals.kind.crated: In crates or kennels (chicks, poultry, pets)
tower.animals.f.movementPermit: Movement permit number (where one is needed)
tower.animals.f.citesListed: The species is listed under CITES
tower.animals.f.attendantName: Who looks after them on the way
tower.animals.attendantHint: Leave it empty and the driver is their handler on the way, and is told so.
tower.animals.f.shipperCertifiedBy: Who signed the shipper’s certification for live animals
tower.animals.certificationHint: The airline asks for it with each shipment. Only the shipper signs it — never SeeBuyGet, never the forwarder.
tower.animals.f.fitToTravel: None is sick or injured, in the last tenth of its pregnancy, has given birth in the last 48 hours, or is a newborn with an unhealed navel
tower.animals.originalsHint: The truck must be made for them: a livestock body for livestock, a closed vehicle with air for crates. The driver looks them over at pickup and has the original papers before taking them.
tower.animals.f.vetPlace: The place the veterinary officer named
tower.animals.f.namedOn: Where it was named (the permit, or the officer)
tower.animals.vetPlaceHint: The animals go there and nowhere else: the road leg cannot be sent to any other place.
tower.animals.vetPlaceKept: Named: {place}. Once a truck is posted for them, it does not change.
tower.animals.vetPlaceImporter: The importer names the place the veterinary officer named; the animals go there and nowhere else.
tower.animals.held: {count} {species}, to {place} only — named on {namedOn}. {by} gave their word that none is unfit to travel.
tower.animals.heldNoPlace: {count} {species}. {by} gave their word that none is unfit to travel. The importer has not yet named the place the veterinary officer named: no truck is posted until then.
tower.animals.roadTo: To {place} — the place the veterinary officer named, and no other.
tower.journey.title: The journey
tower.fbl.title: The forwarder’s bill of lading
tower.fbl.lede: The bill a freight forwarder issued on FIATA’s form — an FBL, or its waybill, the FWB. SeeBuyGet issues none and vouches for none: keep a copy here with what is printed on it, and read what the form asks, what agrees with our papers, where you can check it is genuine, and what it means.
tower.fbl.against: Read against the form of the {conditions}.
tower.fbl.match.provesNothing: Agreeing with our papers proves nothing about whether the bill is genuine: a forged bill can copy every number.
tower.fbl.genuineTitle: Is it genuine? Check it yourself
tower.fbl.checkedBy: As {by} saw it on FIATA’s page on {day}, with the result attached ({proof}) — their record, not a check by SeeBuyGet.
tower.fbl.recordHint: Checked it on FIATA’s page? Keep what the page showed among your papers — a screenshot or its PDF — and record it here.
tower.fbl.f.registered: The page showed it as registered
tower.fbl.f.proof: What the page showed, from your papers
tower.fbl.rate: Dollars are approximate: 1 SDR = US${usd}, the International Monetary Fund’s rate on {day}.
tower.fbl.replaced: It replaced {n, plural, one {# earlier bill} other {# earlier bills}} — each kept as it was.
tower.fbl.f.seaLeg: The carriage includes a sea or inland waterway leg
tower.fbl.f.printedHint: Tick each box of the form that is filled in.
tower.fbl.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded.
tower.fbl.f.uploadProof: Or upload what the page showed — a screenshot or its PDF
tower.fbl.directoryHint: Is a forwarder or a clearing agent a FIATA member? Look it up yourself, under its country — SeeBuyGet checks nobody’s membership:
tower.fbl.box.signature: Stamp and signature, and as whom
tower.fbl.box.deliveryAgent: For delivery of goods please apply to
tower.byRail.title: Inland by rail
tower.byRail.lede: Where the box comes from the port by train, our truck collects it at the rail terminal. The road leg waits until the railway says the box is there, so no truck is sent to wait for a train.
tower.byRail.fold.waiting: Waiting for the railway’s word that it is at {terminal}
tower.byRail.fold.over: The free days at {terminal} are over
tower.byRail.arrivedAt: The railway said it was there at {when} — recorded by {by}.
tower.byRail.noLegYet: No road leg yet: once it is posted, it waits for the railway’s word.
tower.byRail.takenBefore: A driver took the road leg before the rail leg was recorded: tell them the box may not be at the terminal yet.
tower.byRail.clock.notStarted: The free days at the terminal start when the railway says the box is there.
tower.byRail.clock.running: {days, plural, one {# free day} other {# free days}} at {terminal}, until {until}.
tower.byRail.clock.dueSoon: The last free day at {terminal}: until {until}.
tower.byRail.clock.over: The free days ended on {until}: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} over.
tower.byRail.clock.stopped: Collected on {when}. Days over the free days: {days}.
tower.byRail.f.arrivedAt: When the railway said it was there (UTC)
tower.byRail.anywayHint: Only the importer decides this, and pays for any waiting. Say why — the terminal confirmed by phone, the notice is late.
tower.byRail.leftPortAt: The train left the port with it at {when} — recorded by {by}. The line’s clock outside the terminal runs from then.
tower.byRail.f.leftPort: When the train left the port with it (UTC)
tower.imports.roadTitleRail: The road leg from the rail terminal
tower.rail.f.grossMass: Gross weight of the goods, as printed (kg)
tower.byRail.collectedAt: Collected at {terminal}, where the train brings it.
tower.rail.title: The railway’s note
tower.rail.lede: Where the box goes by rail, the railway issues the note — on paper or in its own system. Keep it here with what is printed on it: it is checked against the rules of its route, and its box number and seals against ours.
tower.rail.fold.notChecked: {number} kept — the railway’s rules not read
tower.rail.against: Read against {rules}, as they stood on {day}.
tower.rail.unless.no_documents: customs or another authority need papers with it
tower.rail.unless.no_seals: the wagon or the box is sealed
tower.rail.unless.nothing_to_pay: the consignee is to pay any charges
tower.rail.replaced: It replaced {n} earlier — each kept as it was.
tower.rail.f.seals: Seals, as printed, with commas between
tower.rail.f.reference: Its reference in the railway’s system
tower.rail.f.printoutLine: The printout says it is a printout of the electronic note
tower.rail.f.printedHint: Tick what you find on the note — only what {rules} ask for.
tower.rail.p.madeOut: Where and when it was made out
tower.rail.p.carrier: The railway that took the contract
tower.rail.p.takenOverOn: The day the railway took it over
tower.rail.p.dangerous: The dangerous goods, as their rules name them
tower.rail.p.documents: The papers for customs that go with it
tower.rail.p.charges: Who pays the carriage, and how
tower.rail.p.dates: The days it leaves and arrives
tower.rail.p.statement: The line saying it is carried under the CIM
tower.imports.need.date: An arrival must be written YYYY-MM-DD.
tower.imports.need.dest: Where is it going? A two-letter country code.
tower.imports.need.origin: Where is it coming from? A two-letter country code.
tower.imports.need.unique: That paper is on the list twice.
tower.imports.needCurrency: A currency is its three letters — ETB, KES, USD.
tower.imports.noneCompany: Nothing here yet. Record an import the moment it is on its way — not when it arrives.
